easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
